The primitives define a layered diagnostic architecture where the Operating Runtime Zone (Z_op) serves as a unified interface for real-time system health. The Jarvis Operating Assessment (A_op) aggregates multiple telemetry signals—company health, risk vectors, Claude review, and gate statuses—into a scalar metric. Agent Reality Counts (N_real/N_draft) provide a binary validation layer that informs A_op's reliability. These operators form a closed-loop system where GSI's Bayesian inference feeds into GSE's state transitions. Failure modes emerge when stale-data warnings exceed thresholds, triggering a degradation in Z_op's fidelity. The system exhibits duality between deterministic diagnostics and probabilistic risk modeling, with Z_op acting as a bridge between them.
